description: Source code for NetworkManagerSecretAgent implementation, handling D-Bus communication, secret management, and agent registration for network security.

classes.name: SecretAgent
classes.description: Implements a D-Bus secret agent for network security, manages registration, and runs a main loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: SecretAgent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the D-Bus connection and starts the security agent.

methods.name: ~SecretAgent
methods.description: Destructor that stops the security agent and releases resources.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a specified number of seconds or until a cancel signal is received.

methods.name: stopWait
methods.description: Signals to cancel any ongoing wait.

methods.name: SecretAgentLoop
methods.description: Main loop for the secret agent, runs in a separate thread, handles D-Bus registration.

methods.name: startSecurityAgent
methods.description: Starts the secret agent in a new thread if not already running.

methods.name: stopSecurityAgent
methods.description: Stops the secret agent and joins the thread.

methods.name: RegisterAgent
methods.description: Registers the agent with NetworkManager via D-Bus.

methods.name: UnregisterAgent
methods.description: Unregisters the agent from NetworkManager via D-Bus.
